hardware_storage.boundary_beat: one 16-byte write to each bank, no separate duplicated transfer
hardware_storage.coefficient_storage: 8 × 22 bits per bank; one/two words written on coefficient result per cycle
hardware_storage.length_bias: Q24 ln(count), micro-ROM for counts 1–32. Count 0 is masked; counts 33–255 are out of contract.
hardware_storage.query_storage: CHUNKS × 512 BITS raw plus the same for unsigned magnitude; four 64-bit g factors
hardware_storage.record_bank_ports: one aggregate 32 B beat per cycle; one independent selected 16 B chunk read; trailing fields held directly
hardware_storage.result_storage: two entries, 192-bit group Q24 score + 32-bit tag + 8-bit count; 1R1W, credits include the dot/score pipeline
hardware_storage.summary_ingress: ordered pre-reassembled DRAM burst stream, no addressed reorder FIFO or CDC
